title: Temperature at state B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates T_B = 330 K using the isobaric volume-temperature relation.

title: Pressure at state C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates p_C = 1.1 × 10^5 Pa using the isochoric pressure-temperature relation.

title: Total heat absorbed Q
description: Essential: Correctly calculates Q = 188 J using the first law of thermodynamics and given ΔU.

title: Pressure at state B
description: Important: Applies force equilibrium on the piston to find p_B = p_0 + mg/S.

title: Work from A to B
description: Important: Calculates work W = p_B * S * d for the isobaric expansion.

title: First law application
description: Important: Correctly relates Q, ΔU, and W with the sign convention Q = ΔU + W (or equivalent).

title: Ideal gas law use
description: Optional: Explicitly uses the ideal gas law to relate states or verify intermediate steps.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities (area, distance, pressure) to consistent SI units.

title: Sign error in first law
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for work (e.g., Q = ΔU - W when W is work done by gas).

title: Pressure equilibrium mistake
description: Pitfall: Omits the piston's weight (mg) when calculating the gas pressure in state B.
